text: oh his last name is Estes, I was thinking his name was Lewis. I think he was National Guard and probably got called up. Lewis must be somebody else. Geutler was the guy flying possibly to the left of Estes. Usually the guy looking back is not flying the plane and he was talking to me.
researchNotes: HOW THE NAME ARRIVED (his son, 2026-09-12): his son said it looked like there was a name on the man's helmet, and Larry read it off the photograph. 'Estes' is therefore his reading of the visor lettering, agreeing with the 2026-08-09 machine reading of it, not an unprompted memory; National Guard and the rest are memory. The comment withdraws his 2026-08-15 identification of the man as Major Lewis (giscus-vn-0016-c18032603.json). 'Geutler ... possibly' is hedged, so Guegler is not linked on the photograph.
